description: Start signing in: answers with a URL the USER opens in the browser where they are already signed in to myportal.onrc.ro (Keycloak answers from that sign-in; no password or code is typed), and the redirect it ends on. Pass that address to complete_login. Open for 15 minutes; beginning again replaces it. Call this whenever a tool answers needs_login.
name: begin_login
title: Begin login
